meta.check: D4 model lexical double-check of candidate_human_nouns.json
meta.criterion: each noun must reliably denote A HUMAN BEING (person: occupation, role, nationality, attribute-bearer) usable as a referent in who-did-what-to-whom stories
meta.method: model Arabic lexical judgement over the full 600, no corpus counts consulted; judgements about DOMINANT Twitter usage are informed estimates, not measurements

decision_rules_applied.nisba_nationality: nationality/affiliation nisbas (اليمني، الكويتي) are human-denoting persons -- keep
decision_rules_applied.occupation_participle: occupation and participle forms are the core -- keep
decision_rules_applied.surname_test: when a word is a common Arabic surname AND a plausible descriptor, ask whether the DEFINITE form still has a live, frequent common-noun use on Twitter beyond the name; if not, veto as proper_name; if yes, keep_with_note recording the collision
decision_rules_applied.collective_rule: veto when the dominant reading is a non-individual collective or institution (الحرس، البوليس، الحريم، الحضر); keep_with_note when it is a countable human plural that merely violates the masculine-singular convention (المشائخ، الدراويش، الكفار، الخدم)
decision_rules_applied.divine_names: veto when the definite standalone form is dominantly a divine name or a name element عبد+X (الرزاق، القهار، الوكيل); keep_with_note when a live human reading dominates despite the divine homograph (المؤمن، الوارث، الرقيب)
decision_rules_applied.relational_adjective: veto nisba/participle forms whose dominant use is attributive to NON-humans and which lack a common bare person-noun use (الفني، الاقتصادي، التقني، الحرفي); keep السياسي because the bare person-noun use is genuinely common

meta.caveat: this is an reviewery model check, not the doc 59 SS6 gate protocol; nothing here is a membership confirmation and no source file was modified
meta.orthographic_variant_of_flagged_note: empty by finding: every orthographic-variant pair detected (المسئول/المسؤول، الانجليزي/الانكليزي/الانقليزي، الاوروبي/الاوربي/الاروبي، الامريكي/الاميركي، اليمني/اليماني، القارئ/القاري، البروفسور/البروفيسور، الاخ/الاخو، الاب/الابو، الطاغية-الطاغيه/الطاغي) is a variant of a KEPT entry, so those are recorded in keep_with_note naming the duplicate rather than vetoed
